lines.text: The law is a shadow, and the blood of lambs and doves cannot take away sins.
Christ said God did not desire sacrifices, but came to do His will, and we are sanctified through His body.
Jesus offered one sacrifice for sins for all time, then sat down at the right hand of God.
The Lord promises to put His laws on their doorposts and to remember their sins no more.
Where sins have been forgiven, an offering for sin is no longer needed.
